name: Cannon
description: Tam Yee Luk won the 2000 Asia Championship with a Cannon Soldier burn deck. Sinister Serpent supplied discard fodder, while Ultimate Offering put extra monsters on the field for Cannon Soldier to Tribute.

defining_cards.name: Cannon Soldier
defining_cards.why: It turned spare monsters into 500 damage apiece, letting combo decks finish a duel without attacking.

defining_cards.name: Ultimate Offering
defining_cards.why: Paying 500 life points granted extra Normal Summons, supplying monsters for Cannon Soldier to tribute.

defining_cards.name: Sinister Serpent
defining_cards.why: Its original effect returned it to the hand in successive Standby Phases, providing a repeatable discard for cards such as Graceful Charity.

defining_cards.name: Sangan
defining_cards.why: Sending it from the field to the Graveyard searched out a low-ATK monster, from a combo piece to another defensive play.

defining_cards.name: Witch of the Black Forest
defining_cards.why: Its 1500 DEF search limit reached high-ATK monsters such as Summoned Skull, replacing the Witch when it left the field for the Graveyard.
